lines.speaker: Surveyor Michael
lines.text: It would be an honour. I won't let you down.
You selected Michael to be your surveying assistant.
The new master of Fetteresso Estate was pleased with your work, and you were paid in full.
Your map is often heralded as an example of exemplary work.
Michael and the Surveyor worked together for many years. When the Surveyor eventually retired, they were happy to leave their craft in Michael's capable hands.
